### `GET /cluster/metrics/export`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.metrics.export.$get()
```

Retrieve metrics of the cluster.

Returns `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `history` | boolean |  | Also return historic values. Returns full available metric history unless `start-time` is also set — default `0` |
| `local-only` | boolean |  | Only return metrics for the current node instead of the whole cluster — default `0` |
| `node-list` | string |  | Only return metrics from nodes passed as comma-separated list |
| `start-time` | number |  | Only include metrics with a timestamp &gt; start-time. — default `0` |
